basic_details.job_title: DLSA Vikarabad Steno/Typist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: District Legal Services Authority, Vikarabad (DLSA Vikarabad), Telangana, has invited applications for the post of Steno/Typist under Advt No. 01/2026. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 16 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand Draft in the name of 'The Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, Vikarabad' payable at Vikarabad.

age_limit.age_details: Completed the age of 18 years and must not have completed 44 years (as on 1 September 2026)

qualification.education_qualification: Degree in Arts, Science, Commerce or Law with Government Technical Examination in Shorthand and Typewriting
qualification.details: Qualification: Degree in Arts or Science or Commerce or Law of a University in India established or incorporated by or a central Act, Provisional Act or a State Act or from any Institution recognized by University Grants Commission or any other degree equivalent to such qualification.; Must have passed Government Technical Examination with a speed of 120 w.p.m. in English Shorthand (or Lower Grade if Higher is not available).; Must have passed Government Technical Examination in Typewriting in Higher Grade in English (45 w.p.m.) (or Lower Grade if Higher is not available).; Must have knowledge or qualification in computer operation. Age limit: Completed the age of 18 years and must not have completed 44 years (as on 1 September 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST/BCs/EWS/Aboriginal Tribes in Agency areas 5 years, Differently-abled 10 years, Ex-Servicemen As per Rule 12(1)(c)(i) of Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules | Other conditions: | Candidates shall not be eligible for appointment if they do not possess adequate knowledge of the language or languages of the district. Must be of sound health and active habits free from bodily defects or infirmities. Must be a citizen of India.

exam_pattern.details: Minimum qualifying marks: 40% for OC and EWS, 35% for Backward Classes, and 30% for SC and ST.

how_to_apply: Fill application in the prescribed proforma.
Enclose required attested copies of certificates and photographs.
Send by Registered Post/Courier only to the specified address.
Superscribe the application cover with 'APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF STENO-TYPIST'.
Make sure it reaches by 16 November 2026.
important_instructions: No application shall be received directly.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Degree in Arts or Science or Commerce or Law of a University in India established or incorporated by or a central Act, Provisional Act or a State Act or from any Institution recognized by University Grants Commission or any other degree equivalent to such qualification.; Must have passed Government Technical Examination with a speed of 120 w.p.m. in English Shorthand (or Lower Grade if Higher is not available).; Must have passed Government Technical Examination in Typewriting in Higher Grade in English (45 w.p.m.) (or Lower Grade if Higher is not available).; Must have knowledge or qualification in computer operation. Age limit: Completed the age of 18 years and must not have completed 44 years (as on 1 September 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST/BCs/EWS/Aboriginal Tribes in Agency areas 5 years, Differently-abled 10 years, Ex-Servicemen As per Rule 12(1)(c)(i) of Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules Other conditions: Candidates shall not be eligible for appointment if they do not possess adequate knowledge of the language or languages of the district. Must be of sound health and active habits free from bodily defects or infirmities. Must be a citizen of India.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for DLSA Vikarabad Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Persons with more than one living wife, or married to a person with a living spouse, where the marriage is void Persons dismissed from government service or convicted for moral turpitude Candidates who bring influence of any kind are disqualified

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment is covered by the Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS)

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Demand Draft in the name of 'The Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, Vikarabad' payable at Vikarabad.

content_sections.heading: How Will DLSA Vikarabad Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: OMR based objective examination Skill Test for Stenography Oral interview (viva-voce) OMR based examination for 40 marks (20 marks General Knowledge and 20 marks General English) for 45 minutes. Skill Test for Stenography for 40 marks (Dictation for 5 minutes in English at 120 w.p.m, transcription within 40 minutes). Oral interview (viva-voce) for 20 marks.

content_sections.heading: DLSA Vikarabad Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Minimum qualifying marks: 40% for OC and EWS, 35% for Backward Classes, and 30% for SC and ST.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Original certificates of prescribed academic qualifications Marks lists and pass certificates Certificate evidencing date of birth Community certificate Certificate in respect of Local/Non-local Two sets of Photostat copies of certificates duly attested by Gazetted Officer No-objection Certificate from Employer if employed anywhere Self-Addressed long envelope duly stamped with a postage of Rs.75/-

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DLSA Vikarabad Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill application in the prescribed proforma. Enclose required attested copies of certificates and photographs. Send by Registered Post/Courier only to the specified address. Superscribe the application cover with 'APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF STENO-TYPIST'. Make sure it reaches by 16 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No application shall be received directly.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DLSA Vikarabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DLSA Vikarabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Steno/Typist.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DLSA Vikarabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Notification proforma) and send it to The Chairman, District Legal Services Authority, District Court Premises, Vikarabad, by registered post/courier, to reach by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: OC and BC categories: Rs. 800. SC and ST categories: Rs. 400.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is completed the age of 18 years and must not have completed 44 years (as on 1 September 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST/BCs/EWS/Aboriginal Tribes in Agency areas 5 years, Differently-abled 10 years, Ex-Servicemen As per Rule 12(1)(c)(i) of Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree in Arts, Science, Commerce or Law with Government Technical Examination in Shorthand and Typewriting.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates shall not be eligible for appointment if they do not possess adequate knowledge of the language or languages of the district. Must be of sound health and active habits free from bodily defects or infirmities. Must be a citizen of India.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Persons with more than one living wife, or married to a person with a living spouse, where the marriage is void. Persons dismissed from government service or convicted for moral turpitude. Candidates who bring influence of any kind are disqualified.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: OMR based objective examination. Skill Test for Stenography. Oral interview (viva-voce). OMR based examination for 40 marks (20 marks General Knowledge and 20 marks General English) for 45 minutes.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment is covered by the Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS).
